prompt: In what year was Google Inc. officially born (incorporated)?
explanation: In August 1998 Andy Bechtolsheim wrote Larry and Sergey a $100,000 check, and Google Inc. was officially born.

source.title: Google: Our story

prompt: In what year did Google rename Google Webmaster Tools to Google Search Console?
explanation: Google announced the rebrand on May 20, 2015, so the tool would include everyone who cares about Search, not just webmasters.

source.title: Google Search Central Blog: Announcing Google Search Console

prompt: In what year does Google say its story began at Stanford University?
explanation: Google traces its story to 1995, when Larry Page and Sergey Brin met at Stanford. Their first search engine, called Backrub, used links to judge how important pages were.

source.title: Google: Our story

prompt: Every day, what percent of Google searches are ones Google has never seen before?
explanation: Google says fifteen percent of daily searches are brand new. People keep finding new ways to ask, which is why writing naturally for real questions matters.

source.title: Google: How Search Works, our approach

prompt: For good responsiveness (INP, a Core Web Vital), a page should react to taps in under how many milliseconds?
explanation: Google suggests an Interaction to Next Paint under 200 milliseconds, so taps and clicks feel quick.

source.title: Google: Understanding Core Web Vitals and Google search results

prompt: Old page redirects to another, then another. Up to how many hops in a redirect chain can Googlebot follow?
explanation: Googlebot can follow up to 10 redirect hops, but Google advises sending people straight to the final page.

source.title: Google: Site moves with URL changes

prompt: In what year did Google AdWords become Google Ads?
explanation: Google AdWords became Google Ads on July 24, 2018, along with a new logo.

source.title: Google Ads Help: Google AdWords is now Google Ads

prompt: How many characters can one headline in a responsive search ad have, at most?
explanation: Responsive search ad headlines allow up to 30 characters each. Descriptions allow up to 90.

source.title: Google Ads Help: About responsive search ads

prompt: How many characters can each description in a responsive search ad have?
explanation: Descriptions get up to 90 characters each, plenty of room to explain your offer and give people a reason to click.

source.title: Google Ads Help: About responsive search ads

prompt: How many characters can sitelink text have in most languages?
explanation: Sitelink text is capped at 25 characters, so short labels like "Book a table" or "Opening hours" work best.

source.title: Google Ads Help: About sitelink assets

prompt: Your daily budget is $10. Your monthly spend limit is how many times that daily budget?
explanation: Google caps monthly spend at about 30.4 times your average daily budget, the average number of days in a month.

source.title: Google Ads Help: About average daily budgets

prompt: You stack several bid adjustments. What is the biggest combined bid increase allowed?
explanation: Combined bid adjustments can raise your bid by up to 900%, so stacking boosts has a ceiling.

source.title: Google Ads Help: About bid adjustments

prompt: What is the maximum number of characters in a YouTube video title?
explanation: YouTube video titles have a limit of 100 characters.

source.title: YouTube Help: Edit video settings

prompt: What is the maximum number of characters in a YouTube video description?
explanation: YouTube video descriptions have a limit of 5,000 characters.

source.title: YouTube Help: Edit video settings

prompt: What is the maximum number of characters allowed in a YouTube playlist title?
explanation: Playlist titles can be up to 150 characters. A clear, searchable title like "Easy weeknight recipes" helps viewers find the playlist.

source.title: YouTube Help: Manage playlists in YouTube Studio

prompt: How many qualified watch hours (last 12 months) does the long-form YPP path need, with 1,000 subs?
explanation: Long-form channels need 1,000 subscribers and 4,000 qualified watch hours in the last 12 months to apply for the YouTube Partner Program. Shorts creators have a separate views path.

source.title: YouTube Help: YouTube Partner Program overview & eligibility

prompt: When you add chapters to a YouTube video, what is the minimum length of each chapter?
explanation: Each chapter must be at least 10 seconds long, and you need at least three of them starting at 00:00.

source.title: YouTube Help: Video chapters

prompt: What percent of confirmed Super Chat and Super Sticker revenue do creators receive?
explanation: Creators get 70% of confirmed Supers revenue, after local sales tax and app store fees are taken out.

source.title: YouTube Help: Manage YouTube Super Chat & Super Stickers for Live Chat

prompt: In what year was Google Maps first launched?
explanation: Google Maps first launched on desktop on February 8, 2005.

source.title: Google Blog: A look back at 15 years of mapping the world

prompt: What is the maximum number of characters allowed in a Business Profile description?
explanation: Google's Business Profile help says not to exceed 750 characters in the description field.

source.title: Google: Edit your Business Profile

prompt: A plumber covers lots of towns. Up to how many service areas can a Business Profile list?
explanation: You can add up to 20 service areas, using cities, postal codes or other areas you serve.

source.title: Google Business Profile Help: Manage your service areas for service-area & hybrid businesses

prompt: You want to add a video tour of your cafe. What's the longest a Business Profile video can be?
explanation: Business Profile videos can be up to 30 seconds long (and up to 75 MB), so keep the tour short and sweet.

source.title: Google Business Profile Help: Manage your Business Profile photos & videos

prompt: Besides the primary category, how many more categories can a Business Profile have, at most?
explanation: You can add up to 9 categories on top of your primary one, though Google advises using as few as describe your core business.

source.title: Google Business Profile Help: Edit your Business Profile

prompt: You get a verification code by postcard. After how many days does that code expire?
explanation: Postcard verification codes expire after 30 days, and most arrive within 14 days, so enter yours soon after it lands.

source.title: Google Business Profile Help: Verify your business on Google

prompt: In what year did Google publish its Search guidance about AI-generated content?
explanation: Google Search Central posted its guidance about AI-generated content on February 8, 2023.

source.title: Google Search Central: Google Search's guidance about AI-generated content

prompt: How many ready-made AI prompts came with the first public release of the FLOW playbook?
explanation: FLOW 1.0.0 (April 2026) shipped a prompt library of 42 standardized AI prompts across its stages.

source.title: GitHub: FLOW changelog

prompt: In what year did Anthropic first introduce its AI assistant Claude to the public?
explanation: Anthropic announced Claude (and a faster, cheaper Claude Instant) on March 14, 2023.

source.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude

prompt: When Google launched Gemini 1.0, how many model sizes did it come in?
explanation: Gemini 1.0 launched in December 2023 in three sizes: Ultra for complex tasks, Pro for everyday scale, and Nano for on-device use.

source.title: Google: Introducing Gemini, our largest and most capable AI model

prompt: Claude reads both text and visuals (charts, images) in PDFs up to how many pages?
explanation: Up to 100 pages, Claude sees charts and images too. Longer PDFs (up to 1,000 pages) get text only.

source.title: Claude Help Center: Upload files to Claude

prompt: How many files can you upload to a single Claude chat, at most?
explanation: You can add up to 20 files to one chat, each up to 500MB.

source.title: Claude Help Center: Upload files to Claude

prompt: How many non-owner users (full or restricted) can one Search Console property have, at most?
explanation: Google caps a Search Console property at 100 non-owner users. Owners are counted separately.

source.title: Google: Managing owners, users, and permissions in Search Console

prompt: Up to how many Google Ads accounts can be linked to a single email address?
explanation: Google says up to 20 Google Ads accounts can share one email address. Beyond that, a manager account is the best option.

source.title: Google Ads Help: About Google Ads manager accounts

prompt: Someone requests ownership of your client's Business Profile. How many days does the owner get to reply?
explanation: The current owner is emailed and has 3 days. If there's no reply, the client may be able to claim the profile.

source.title: Google Business Profile Help: Request ownership of a Business Profile

prompt: What minimum optimization score (in %) must a Google Partner's registered manager account keep?
explanation: Partners need at least 70%, and you stay in control: you can apply or dismiss recommendations based on your clients' goals.

source.title: Google Ads Help: How to become a Google Partner or Premier Partner

prompt: A Google Partner's manager account must keep a 90-day ad spend of how many US dollars across clients?
explanation: The spend requirement for Google Partner status is a 90-day ad spend of $10,000 USD across the accounts the agency manages.

source.title: Google Ads Help: How to become a Google Partner or Premier Partner

prompt: You invite an editor to a client's YouTube channel. After how many days does an unused invite expire?
explanation: A YouTube channel permission invite expires after 30 days, so resend it if your helper misses it.

source.title: YouTube Help: Add or remove access to your YouTube channel with channel permissions
